chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, we are a Household who grieve before the calamity; then, when the command of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, descends, we are content with His decree and submit to His command, and it is not for us to dislike what Allah has loved for us.

key_terms.أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لَنَا: what Allah has chosen and loved for us
key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: the Household, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْمُصِيبَةِ: a calamity or affliction that befalls a person

ai.seo_question: How should a believer respond to calamity according to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the conduct of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام in the face of affliction: natural human grief may arise before a calamity, but once Allah’s decree takes effect, they meet it with riḍā and taslīm. It highlights submission to the divine decree and not disliking what Allah has chosen.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.567 - (Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Hussain narrates from) Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"We, the people of the household (AhlulBayt (as)), may become distressed before a calamity occurs, but when the command of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, comes to pass, we are content with His decree and submit to His command. We do not have the right to dislike what Allah (swt) has chosen for us."
